column1: # Contested points APPROVED by Dave (second decisions, 2026-10-27): where Christian traditions genuinely differ.
# Columns: code | name | what the disagreement is about | Nave's topics, each followed by :whole or :part, separated by ';'
#   :whole  the topic as a whole is the disputed point (subjects.contested = 1; lessons on it get a version per tradition)
#   :part   the topic is mostly common ground; only a lesson that reaches the disputed point needs "Where Christians differ"

column3: Who should be baptized (believers only, or infants too), how (immersion, pouring, sprinkling) and what baptism does.
What the bread and cup are (memorial, spiritual presence, real presence) and who may take them.
Whether God chooses who will be saved unconditionally (Reformed, Lutheran in part) or on foreseen faith (Wesleyan/Arminian).
Whether a true believer can finally fall away ("once saved, always saved").
Whether Christians can reach entire sanctification or Christian perfection in this life (Wesleyan and Holiness view).
Premillennial, postmillennial and amillennial readings of the thousand years, and who or what the Antichrist is.
Whether the Sabbath command carries over to Sunday (the Lord's Day) and how strictly it should be kept.
Whether the miraculous gifts (tongues, prophecy, healing) continue today, and whether tongues mark baptism in the Holy Spirit.
